concept: Graph-Guided Hallucination Mitigation and Factual Consistency Verification
summary: Ground-truth subgraph path verification, counterfactual edge pruning, and bidirectional entailment checking to eliminate factual hallucinations.

related.concept: Bitemporal Knowledge Graphs and Entity Resolution
Ontology-Constrained Information Extraction and Triplet Mining
Graph-Structured Agent Episodic and Semantic Memory Architecture

facts.text: Verifying generated statements against a verified reference knowledge graph via subgraph path matching detects hallucinated entity relations with higher precision than text-only semantic similarity models.
Counterfactual edge pruning removes unsupported relational hops from candidate generation contexts, increasing RAGAS faithfulness scores from 0.78 to > 0.85 on complex factual QA benchmarks.
Bidirectional entailment checking between extracted response triples and retrieved context subgraphs provides verifiable token-level citation attribution without post-hoc manual labeling.
